decision.explanation: The documents explicitly state Enrique Matta Figueroa held the position of 'deputy of Chile' (D1S2, D1S7, D1S14) and was appointed 'Minister of Finance' in Brazil (D2S2). Document D1S3 provides the specific formal title 'member of the Chamber of Deputies of Chile', which is a direct synonym for 'deputy of Chile' in this context and represents a valid, distinct phrasing of the same office found in the source text. Other candidates like 'lawyer' or 'politician' are described as general professions or roles rather than specific positions held, and 'representative of the Liberal Party' describes party affiliation rather than the office itself.
